note: Living data file, not code. Every row is sourced to an upstream issue/PR thread. Update cadence is independent of package releases: edit this file directly via community PR, or run `npm run matrix:update` to refresh upstream issue status.

entries.knownBehavior: qwen3 reasoning parser routes everything before the closing think tag into reasoning; downstream tool parsing only inspects content, so tool calls emitted inside the think block never reach the tool parser. Confirmed root cause on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-FP8 (qwen3 + qwen3_coder parser combo), independently reproduced on Qwen3.5-27B-AWQ.
entries.fixHint: Upgrade to vLLM >= 0.24.0 (Qwen3 family). Interim: treat <tool_call> as an implicit think-block boundary (community patch; upstream PR #35687 covers this for the qwen3_xml parser).

entries.knownBehavior: Partially patched; still misses the paired tool_call-block case from the original report.

entries.knownBehavior: qwen3_coder / qwen3_xml parser names collapsed onto one class; the 'switch the parser flag' folk-fix is now a no-op.
entries.fixHint: Do not rely on switching --tool-call-parser between the qwen3_coder and qwen3_xml names on current versions.

entries.knownBehavior: Tool calls swallowed into reasoning_content / malformed; 4.8% defective turns observed on a Qwen3.5-9B runtime LoRA, absent for base+identity weights on the same server.
Qwen3.5-9B often prints tool calls in XML and stops when thinking is enabled — tool calls inside the thinking block are lost from the parsed tool_calls.

Reasoning tags leak into conversation history and the model starts imitating/duplicating fake thinking tags over subsequent turns. Not a per-response repair — the fix is a history hygiene pass that strips reasoning artifacts before re-sending.
entries.fixHint: Run the Pattern D hygiene pass (sanitizeHistory / stripReasoningTags) over conversation history before the next request.
